description:
Allow users to control how subtasks are displayed across task views.

## Background
Currently subtasks are always shown nested under parent tasks. Users may want different views:
- Nested: Subtasks indented under parent (current default)
- Flat: Subtasks as independent items
- Hidden: Only show parent tasks, hide subtasks

## Requirements

### 1. Create Settings Hook
- `useSubtaskDisplayMode(view)` hook
- Mode: 'nested' | 'flat' | 'hidden'
- Persist to localStorage per view (list, kanban, eisenhower)
- Default to 'nested'

### 2. Add UI Toggle
- Add to display menu in TaskDesktopLayout
- Add to sort menu in KanbanBoard
- Add to EisenhowerMatrix header
- Use radio buttons or dropdown

### 3. Update Views

**TaskList:**
- 'nested': Current behavior (group subtasks under parents)
- 'flat': Show all tasks, don't group
- 'hidden': Filter out tasks with parent_task_id

**KanbanBoard:**
- 'nested': Show count on parent cards (current)
- 'flat': Show subtasks as separate cards in their status column
- 'hidden': Only show parent tasks

**EisenhowerMatrix:**
- 'nested': Group subtasks under parents in each quadrant
- 'flat': Show all tasks independently
- 'hidden': Only show parent tasks

### 4. Visual Indicators
- In 'flat' mode, show parent title on subtask cards: "↳ Parent Task"
- In 'nested' mode, show progress (X/Y) on parent

## Files to Modify
- `zettelkasten-front/src/hooks/useSubtaskDisplayMode.ts` (new)
- `zettelkasten-front/src/components/tasks/TaskList.tsx`
- `zettelkasten-front/src/components/tasks/KanbanBoard.tsx`
- `zettelkasten-front/src/components/tasks/EisenhowerMatrix.tsx`
- `zettelkasten-front/src/components/tasks/TaskDesktopLayout.tsx`

## Acceptance Criteria
- Toggle visible and functional in all three views
- Mode persists across page reloads
- Default is 'nested' for all views
- Subtasks display correctly in each mode
- No performance regression with large task lists

## Priority
Medium - Quality of life improvement for task management

Depends on: Subtasks feature (completed)
title: Add subtask display mode toggle (Nested/Flat/Hidden)

- Request deduplication

close_reason: API endpoints implemented: CreateSubtask, SetParent, GetSubtasks
description:
Create REST API endpoints for subtask CRUD operations.

## Endpoints

### POST /api/tasks/:id/subtasks
- Create new task as child of parent
- Inherit parent's priority and tags
- Set parent_task_id to URL param :id
- Return 201 with created Task

### PATCH /api/tasks/:id/parent
- Set or clear parent_task_id
- Validate single-level nesting (parent can't have parent)
- Validate no self-reference
- Validate task doesn't have children (can't nest a parent)
- Return 200 with updated Task

### GET /api/tasks/:id/subtasks
- Return all children of parent
- Include complete_count in response

## Files to modify
- go-backend/routes/tasks.go
- go-backend/handlers/tasks.go
- go-backend/services/tasks.go

## Acceptance Criteria
- All endpoints return correct HTTP status codes
- Validation errors return 400 with clear message
- Subtasks correctly linked to parent

Depends on: Zettelgarden-qd4 (model update)
title: Add subtask API endpoints
